title: Kunjali Marakkar
overview: Tells the story of the legendary 16th century naval captain Mohammed, a brave warrior and merchant supported the Samoodiri in his fight against the Portuguese. The Samoodiri honoured Mohammed by making him his naval chief and renaming him ‘Kunjali Marakkar'

songs.title: Aatinakkare
songs.singers: P. Jayachandran, Ak Sukumaran, A.P. Komala, B. Vasantha, K.P. Chandramohan
